heading: Deliveries
description: What happened to each message for each recipient, newest first. Times are UTC.
unreachable: The mail server's management API is unreachable. Check that the server is running and the panel is configured.
disabled: The delivery log is turned off on the server. Set a retention above 0 days for it in the server's storage settings to record deliveries.
full: The API returns at most 100 records and has no next page. Narrow the list with the filters to see others.
